# Markdown Article Rendering, Article Nav Split, PDF Export, and Search/Filters

## Summary

Implemented proper markdown rendering via the `marked` library, separated the Article navigation from the main site menu, removed the article section from the homepage, added PDF export for article pages, rewrote the articles listing page with live search and category/tag filtering, improved Vanpedia term content rendering with markdown, and added custom CSS styles for article typography (with `@tailwindcss/typography` not installed).

## Changes

- **`src/components/ArticleContent.tsx`** — Rewrote markdown rendering to use the `marked` library (v18) instead of a custom block-based parser. Replaced `[[slug]]` Vanpedia markers with sentinel tokens (`__VANPEDIA_LINK_<slug>__<label>__`) before parsing so `<Link>` elements survive the markdown-to-HTML conversion. Uses `marked.parse()` with `async: false` for synchronous rendering. Returns a related-terms aside at the bottom of each article. Removed `prose` utility classes (typography plugin not installed).
- **`src/components/VanpediaPage.tsx`** — Updated Vanpedia term content rendering to use `marked.parse()` for proper markdown output (headers, lists, code blocks, blockquotes, tables) instead of naive paragraph wrapping. Removed `prose` utility classes.
- **`src/index.css`** — Added comprehensive custom CSS for `[data-article-content]` selectors covering headings, paragraphs, lists, links, code blocks, inline code, blockquotes, tables, and horizontal rules for both light and dark themes.
- **`src/components/ArticlesPage.tsx`** — Completely rewritten: added live search bar (by title/summary/tags), category filter pills, conditional tag filter pills (shown when a category is selected), results count, empty state with clear-filters button, and clear-all-filters link. Wired `filteredArticles` via `useMemo`.
- **`src/components/ArticlePage.tsx`** — Added PDF download via `html2canvas` + `jspdf` (A4 multi-page, scale 2). Download button in footer shows a spinner during generation. Share button retained.
- **`src/components/Navbar.tsx`** — Split `navItems` into `mainNavItems` (Hero/About/Experience/Skills/Systems/Approach/Contact) and a separate right-aligned Articles nav group (rose-themed, standalone `<nav>` element) on desktop; mobile drawer entry preserved.
- **`src/App.tsx`** — Removed `<Blog />` from rendering in `HomePage` and removed its import (Blog section removed from homepage). Added `import React from 'react'` for React.FC namespace support.
- **`src/components/Blog.tsx`** — Deleted (no longer imported anywhere; ArticlesPage handles the article listing).
- **`src/components/BlogModal.tsx`** — Deleted (was removed earlier; confirmed no references remain).
- **`src/data/portfolioData.ts`** — Removed orphaned `blogPostsData` content; restored truncated `philosophy` section; removed `BlogPost` from type imports.

## Dependencies Added

- `marked@18.0.12` — Markdown parser for article & Vanpedia term content.
- `html2canvas` — Canvas-based HTML-to-image capture for PDF export.
- `jspdf` — PDF document generation for article page downloads.

## Validation Performed

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — passes with zero TypeScript errors.
- `npm run build` — production build succeeds (~14s, 1959 modules transformed; 1711 bundled). CSS 56.00 kB, JS 1,085.30 kB.
- Verified `marked.parse()` returns synchronous `string` with `async: false`.
- Confirmed `@tailwindcss/typography` not installed — replaced `prose` classes with explicit `[data-article-content]` CSS rules.
